headline: Syngene International shares surge 12% on sequential profit recovery
hook: Biggest one-day gain in six years
summary: Syngene International shares surged 12% in their largest single-day gain in six years following a sequential turnaround in September-quarter profit. The company reported a profit of ₹32.2 crore, recovering from a net loss in the June quarter. For Indian retail investors, the sharp rebound signals improving operational performance despite an overall year-on-year profit decline. This turnaround in contract research operations highlights renewed buying interest in the mid-cap pharma space.

headline: Syngene International Q2 net profit tumbles 52% to Rs 32 crore
hook: Profit halves on falling Zoetis revenue
summary: Syngene International reported a 52 percent year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 32 crore, alongside an 8.6 percent drop in revenue to Rs 833 crore. EBITDA margin narrowed sharply to 17.7 percent from 21.9 percent a year ago, pressured by lower Zoetis revenue and forex hedge losses. Despite the weak earnings, the company secured its first manufacturing agreement for the Bayview biologics facility and a clinical supplies contract in Bengaluru. Indian retail investors holding pharma and contract research stocks face near-term margin pressure at key sector players.
why_it_matters: Syngene shareholders absorb a steep profit drop on margin contraction
